question: Which broad, strictly prior oil-session state—if any—finances the unchanged high-cadence raw CL/MCL macro auction without replacing its direction?

windows.validation_law: entry counts and causal category labels only; no return, MFE, MAE, PnL, ranking, or selection

unchanged_lifecycle.source: v9 retrace2/state24 completed CL turn plus same-sign completed matched-MCL move
unchanged_lifecycle.opposite_direction: close and flip at the same next open
unchanged_lifecycle.contract_roll: close old matched MCL and remain flat until a fresh post-roll turn; no synthetic reopen

frozen_categorical_anatomy.tr_phase: high/low crossed with up/down/flat TR velocity
frozen_categorical_anatomy.gap_bias: aligned, opposed, or balanced relative to raw direction
frozen_categorical_anatomy.damage_phase: aligned, opposed, or balanced relative to raw direction

successor_eligibility.scope: at most one declared categorical field and one natural category or adjacent two-category union
successor_eligibility.discovery_breadth: >=60 trades, both directions, both GTH/RTH lanes, >=6 active months
successor_eligibility.validation_count_breadth: >=60 entries, both directions, both GTH/RTH lanes
successor_eligibility.discovery_economics: positive primary and stress net, stress PF >=1.10, stress PnL/DD >=1.00, <=40% positive-month concentration
successor_eligibility.next_step: a qualifying category may only seed a separate outcome-blind successor count census; it does not become a gate from this anatomy

prohibitions: no continuous return, velocity, acceleration, TR, gap, drawdown, time, or magnitude sweep
no route inversion, exit rescue, stop, target, timeout, quota, or replacement
no production refactor, news, order, or capital authority
